contracts: verify.h owns the public driver verification declaration boundary
verify.c owns the current-process signature sidecar path builder
SeLocateProcessImageName output is a counted UNICODE_STRING not a trusted null-terminated source string
The sidecar path allocation reserves processFileName Length bytes plus .sig plus one Unicode terminator
signatureFileName Length excludes the terminator and signatureFileName MaximumLength includes it
The implementation must not use wcscpy or wcscat on the returned process image buffer
runtime_gate: Windows driver build plus signed-process verification smoke where the process image path has normal and near-limit lengths, and malformed or missing image-name state fails without reading past the counted UNICODE_STRING
